datasets.title: Guatemala Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic Data for 2020
datasets.description: Guatemala Current Situation FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2020. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/guatemala_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2020, classifying geographic areas into food insecurity phases. The spatial data represents post-assessment impact classifications reflecting food insecurity outcomes across Guatemala's administrative units.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes triggered by underlying hazards including drought.
